note: schema.sql, security.sql and TRACEABILITY.tsv are generated from datamodel.json by generate.py. A hash moving without datamodel.json moving means someone hand-edited a generated file, which SW-ADR-066 forbids. NOTE: a hash comparison is the WEAKER check — it cannot see content the spec never contained, which is how the SW-ADR-129 isolation hole survived. The authoritative check is `py "docs/06 DataModel/generate.py" --check`, which compares content, and tools/consistency_check.py runs it.
algorithm: sha256, first 16 hex characters, over the file's exact bytes
